title: Textile Supervisor
description:
Company : Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 



 Location : Tirupur, Tamil Nadu
 



 Salary : ₹16,000 – ₹25,000 per month
 



 Experience : 2–7 years
 



 Employment Type : Full\-time
 



  





 \#\#\# About the Role
 



  





 We are looking for a hands\-on \*\*Production Supervisor – Textiles\*\* to supervise and follow up the complete garment production process on a daily basis.
 



  





 The primary responsibility is to ensure that production moves smoothly from:
 



  





 \*\*Cutting → Stitching → Checking → Finishing → Ironing → Packing\*\*
 



  





 The candidate should be active on the production floor, regularly follow up with workers and departments, identify delays early, and ensure production targets are completed on time with the required quality.
 



  





 \#\#\# Key Responsibilities
 



  





 \* Supervise and follow up \*\*daily garment production from cutting to final packing\*\*.
 



 \* Track every running style, colour, size, and production lot through each stage.
 



 \* Follow up with cutting, stitching, checking, finishing, ironing, and packing teams.
 



 \* Ensure planned production quantities are completed according to daily and weekly targets.
 



 \* Monitor pending quantities at every production stage.
 



 \* Identify production delays, bottlenecks, and manpower shortages and immediately follow up for resolution.
 



 \* Ensure work does not remain pending unnecessarily between departments.
 



 \* Maintain clear production status for each running order.
 



 \* Coordinate priorities based on production plans, stock requirements, and urgent orders.
 



 \* Ensure correct styles, colours, sizes, measurements, and quantities are being produced.
 



 \* Monitor production quality during each stage instead of waiting until final checking.
 



 \* Coordinate rework or corrections wherever quality problems are identified.
 



 \* Ensure finished products are properly checked, packed, counted, and handed over to the warehouse.
 



 \* Compare planned quantity, produced quantity, rejected quantity, and pending quantity.
 



 \* Monitor production wastage and help reduce avoidable rework and rejection.
 



  





 \#\#\# Sampling \& New Style Follow\-Up
 



  





 \* Follow up on \*\*samples and new product developments\*\* when required.
 



 \* Coordinate cutting, stitching, checking, and finishing of samples.
 



 \* Ensure sample corrections are completed properly before bulk production.
 



 \* Understand approved sample requirements before production begins.
 



 \* Communicate important construction, measurement, and quality requirements to the production team.
 



 \* Ensure bulk production follows the approved sample.
 



  





 \#\#\# Production Planning \& Follow\-Up
 



  





 \* Understand daily and weekly production requirements from management.
 



 \* Allocate priorities to production teams accordingly.
 



 \* Maintain a simple daily production tracking report.
 



 \* Keep management updated about completed, pending, and delayed production.
 



 \* Highlight material shortages or operational problems before they affect production.
 



 \* Coordinate with stores and warehouse teams for required materials and finished\-goods movement.
 



  





 \#\#\# Worker \& Floor Supervision
 



  





 \* Supervise workers involved in different production stages.
 



 \* Allocate work based on production priority and manpower availability.
 



 \* Follow up continuously until assigned work is completed.
 



 \* Ensure workers maintain productivity, quality, and discipline.
 



 \* Maintain proper workflow and cleanliness on the production floor.
 



 \* Coordinate between departments to avoid idle time and unnecessary waiting.
 



 \* Escalate recurring productivity or quality issues to management.
 



  





 \#\#\# Quality Control
 



  





 \* Ensure garments meet required standards for:
 



  





 \* Measurements
 



 \* Stitching quality
 



 \* Fabric quality
 



 \* Colour
 



 \* Finishing
 



 \* Thread trimming
 



 \* Ironing
 



 \* Packing
 



 \* Identify defects early and arrange correction before large quantities are completed.
 



 \* Reduce rejection, alteration, and rework wherever possible.
 



  





 \#\#\# Daily Production Monitoring
 



  





 The Production Supervisor should always know:
 



  





 \* What is currently under cutting
 



 \* What is under stitching
 



 \* What quantity is pending
 



 \* What is under checking and finishing
 



 \* What requires rework
 



 \* What is ready for packing
 



 \* What production has been completed
 



 \* What is delayed and why
 



 \* What quantity has been handed over to finished stock
 



  





 \#\#\# Candidate Requirements
 



  





 \* \*\*Minimum 2 years and maximum 7 years of relevant experience\*\*.
 



 \* Experience in garments, knitwear, textiles, production, or manufacturing supervision.
 



 \* Tirupur garment or knitwear industry experience is strongly preferred.
 



 \* Good understanding of the garment production process from \*\*cutting to packing\*\*.
 



 \* Strong production follow\-up ability.
 



 \* Ability to supervise workers and coordinate multiple departments.
 



 \* Good understanding of garment quality and basic measurement requirements.
 



 \* Ability to identify production delays and take corrective action.
 



 \* Basic knowledge of production reports, Excel, or Google Sheets is preferred.
 



 \* Should be practical, organised, responsible, and comfortable working directly on the production floor.
 



 \* Tamil communication is essential.
 



  





 \#\#\# What We Are Looking For
 



  





 We need someone who does not simply collect production updates.
 



  





 The Production Supervisor should actively drive the production cycle:
 



  





 \*\*Cutting → Stitching → Checking → Finishing → Packing → Finished Stock\*\*
 



  





 If production is delayed at any stage, the supervisor should identify where it is stuck, follow up with the concerned person, and ensure the work moves forward.
 



  





 Strong \*\*follow\-up, floor control, production knowledge, and accountability\*\* are the most important qualities for this role.
 



  





 \#\#\# Salary
 



  





 \*\*₹16,000 – ₹25,000 per month\*\*
 



  





 Salary will be decided based on textile production experience, garment knowledge, team\-handling ability, production follow\-up skills, and overall capability.

title: Head of Information Technology
description:
**Company Description** 
 FAMOUS KNIT is a future\-ready apparel manufacturer in India that focuses on responsible, enduring systems rather than scale alone. Guided by four core pillars—Product Excellence, Process Discipline, Purposeful Sustainability, and Progressive Thinking—the company integrates design thinking, digital tools, data insights, and low\-carbon manufacturing across its operations. Its culture emphasizes responsibility over mere compliance, ownership over rigid hierarchy, and long\-term partnership over transactional relationships. FAMOUS KNIT measures success through capability, credibility, and culture, offering sourcing partners a responsive and collaborative approach. The organization is committed to redefining how apparel is made in India for global markets.
 



**Role Description** 
 The Head of Information Technology will lead the overall IT function, ensuring that systems, infrastructure, and processes support FAMOUS KNIT’s strategic and operational goals. This full\-time, on\-site role is based in Tirupur and oversees IT operations, including network and server management, hardware and software administration, and cybersecurity. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include developing and executing IT strategy, managing IT budgets, guiding digital integration across the manufacturing and supply chain ecosystem, and driving data\-led decision\-making through robust systems and reporting. The role will also involve leading an IT team, establishing policies and standards, coordinating with cross\-functional stakeholders, and ensuring that technology initiatives align with sustainability and process discipline goals. The Head of IT will be expected to evaluate and implement new technologies, manage vendors, and ensure high system availability and reliability.
 



**Qualifications** 



* Strong foundation in Information Technology, with experience overseeing enterprise\-wide systems and solutions.
* Demonstrated expertise in IT Management and IT Operations, including team leadership, budgeting, and service delivery.
* Proven ability to define and implement IT Strategy that supports business growth, process discipline, and digital integration.
* Hands\-on experience with Infrastructure management, including networks, servers, cloud solutions, and cybersecurity controls.
* Experience in manufacturing or supply chain environments, ideally within apparel or similar industries.
* Ability to drive data\-led decision\-making through ERP, MIS, analytics tools, and integrated digital platforms.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate across leadership, operations, and sustainability teams.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* Excellent problem\-solving, communication, and organizational skills, with a focus on reliability, security, and continuous improvement.

title: DISPATCH INCHARGE – E-COMMERCE, FBA & STOCK
description:
📢 \*\*WE’RE HIRING: DISPATCH INCHARGE – E\-COMMERCE, FBA \& STOCK
 





 \*\* 📍 \*\*Location:\*\* Tirupur, Tamil Nadu 🏢
 





 \*\*Company:\*\* Robinbosky / ASM Knits
 





 🏭 \*\*Industry:\*\* Apparel Manufacturing \| E\-commerce \| Retail
 





 💰 \*\*
 
**Salary:\*\* ₹18,000 – ₹30,000** 

 per month
 





 🧑‍💼 \*\*Experience:\*\* 2–7 Years
 





 We are looking for an organised and responsible
 
 ﻿
 
 \*\*Dispatch Incharge\*\* to independently handle our \*\*offline orders, bulk shipments, Amazon FBA shipments, marketplace dispatches and stock maintenance\*\*. The candidate should have strong warehouse coordination skills, accuracy in stock handling and the ability to ensure that every shipment leaves \*\*on time, in the correct quantity and with proper documentation\*\*. \#\#\# KEY RESPONSIBILITIES \*\*
 





 1\. Daily Dispatch Management\*\*
 





 • Plan and supervise day\-to\-day dispatch activities
 





 • Ensure orders are picked, checked, packed and dispatched on time
 





 • Handle offline, wholesale, bulk and institutional orders
 





 • Coordinate courier, transport and logistics pickups
 





 • Verify quantity, SKU, size, colour and packing before dispatch
 





 • Ensure correct invoices, labels and shipment documents are attached
 





 • Maintain daily dispatch records and trackers
 





 • Follow up until shipments are handed over successfully
 





 \*\*2\. Amazon FBA \& Bulk Shipments\*\*
 





 • Prepare bulk inventory for Amazon FBA shipments
 





 • Coordinate FBA shipment quantities and SKU\-wise stock
 





 • Ensure correct product labelling, carton labelling and packing
 





 • Verify shipment plans against physically packed quantities
 





 • Prepare cartons according to marketplace requirements
 





 • Maintain carton\-wise and SKU\-wise shipment records
 





 • Coordinate transport / pickup for bulk FBA consignments
 





 • Track shipments until warehouse delivery
 





 • Identify shortages, discrepancies or rejected quantities and follow up for resolution
 





 \*\*3\. Marketplace Shipments\*\*
 





 Coordinate dispatch requirements for marketplaces including:
 





 • Amazon
 





 • Flipkart
 





 • Myntra
 





 • Meesho
 





 • JioMart
 





 • Shopify / D2C orders
 





 • Other e\-commerce channels as required Ensure marketplace orders are processed within required timelines and avoid delays or dispatch errors.
 





 \*\*4\. Offline \& Bulk Orders\*\*
 





 • Handle distributor, retailer, wholesale and other offline shipments
 





 • Prepare order\-wise picking and packing requirements
 





 • Coordinate large\-volume dispatches
 





 • Verify final quantities against invoices / orders
 





 • Coordinate transport arrangements for bulk consignments
 





 • Maintain proof of dispatch and delivery documentation
 





 \*\*5\. Stock Maintenance\*\*
 





 • Maintain accurate physical stock of finished goods
 





 • Ensure inward and outward stock movements are recorded correctly
 





 • Maintain SKU / style / colour / size\-wise stock
 





 • Conduct regular physical stock verification
 





 • Identify stock mismatches and investigate differences
 





 • Monitor damaged, returned, rejected and non\-saleable stock separately
 





 • Coordinate stock transfers between production, warehouse and dispatch
 





 • Ensure stock is stored systematically for easy identification and picking
 





 \*\*6\. Warehouse Organisation\*\*
 





 • Ensure products are stored in clearly identified locations
 





 • Maintain proper racks, bins and SKU identification
 





 • Improve picking and packing efficiency
 





 • Ensure stock is not mixed between styles, sizes or colours
 





 • Maintain cleanliness and organisation in the dispatch and stock areas
 





 • Monitor packing\-material availability
 





 • Inform management in advance when cartons, covers, labels or other materials are running low
 





 \*\*7\. Returns \& Stock Reconciliation\*\*
 





 • Receive returned shipments and verify quantities
 





 • Coordinate checking of returned products
 





 • Segregate saleable, damaged and defective returns
 





 • Ensure returned stock is correctly updated in inventory
 





 • Maintain proper records of marketplace and customer returns
 





 • Report discrepancies to the operations team / management
 





 \*\*8\. Team Handling\*\*
 





 • Allocate work to picking, packing and dispatch staff
 





 • Monitor daily productivity and pending orders
 





 • Ensure staff follow correct packing and stock\-handling processes
 





 • Train new warehouse / dispatch employees
 





 • Maintain discipline and accountability within the dispatch team
 





 • Coordinate closely with production, e\-commerce, accounts and operations teams
 





 \#\#\# REPORTING \& CONTROL The Dispatch Incharge should regularly track:
 





 • Orders pending for dispatch
 





 • Orders dispatched
 





 • FBA shipments pending / completed
 





 • Bulk shipments
 





 • Courier / transporter handovers
 





 • Physical stock
 





 • Stock discrepancies
 





 • Returns received
 





 • Damaged / rejected stock
 





 • Packing\-material availability Any mismatch or delay should be identified and reported quickly rather than discovered later during reconciliation.
 





 \#\#\# CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS
 





 • \*\*2–7 years of experience\*\* in dispatch, warehouse, inventory or logistics operations
 





 • Experience in garments, textiles, e\-commerce or consumer products preferred
 





 • Experience handling \*\*bulk shipments and inventory\*\*
 





 • Amazon FBA / marketplace dispatch experience will be a strong advantage
 





 • Good understanding of SKU\-wise stock maintenance
 





 • Strong numerical accuracy and attention to detail
 





 • Basic knowledge of Excel / Google Sheets
 





 • Comfortable working with invoices, shipment labels and dispatch documents
 





 • Ability to manage warehouse / packing staff
 





 • Good coordination and follow\-up skills
 





 • Ability to handle multiple dispatch priorities simultaneously
 





 • Responsible for stock accuracy and timely shipment completion
 





 \#\#\# IDEAL CANDIDATE We are looking for someone who can independently take ownership of:
 





 \*\*Stock → Order → Picking → Checking → Packing → Documentation → Dispatch → Tracking → Reconciliation
 





 \*\* The person should understand that dispatch is not simply moving cartons out of the warehouse. The responsibility is to ensure:
 





 ✅ \*\*Right Product\*\* ✅ \*\*Right SKU \& Quantity\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Packing\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Documentation\*\* ✅ \*\*Right Destination\*\* ✅ \*\*On\-Time Dispatch\*\* ✅ \*\*Accurate Closing Stock\*\*
 





 \#\#\# COMPENSATION 💰 \*\*₹18,000 – ₹30,000 per month
 





 \*\* Final salary will depend on:
 





 • Previous dispatch / warehouse experience
 





 • Stock\-management capability
 





 • Amazon FBA / e\-commerce experience
 





 • Bulk\-shipment handling experience
 





 • Team\-handling ability
 





 • Accuracy and independent working capability
